name: Tool Installation
query:
Select TI.name AS "Document No:Link/TMS Tool Installation",
TI.posting_date AS "Date:Date",
TI.branch AS "Branch",
TI.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer",
TI.customer_name AS "Customer Name",
TI.installation_status AS "Status",
TI.cpc_component AS "CPC Component",
TI.machine AS "Machine",
TI.operation AS "Operation",
TI.production_line AS "Production Line",
TI.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item",
TI.physical_tool_code AS "Physical Tool Code",
TI.tool_type AS "Tool Type",
TC.condition_name AS "Condition",
TI.installation_date AS "Installation Date",
TI.starting_production_counter AS "Production Counter",
TI.planned_tool_life AS "Tool Life",
TI.installed_by AS "Installed By",
TI.removal_reference AS "Removal Doc:Link/TMS Tool Removal"

From `tabTMS Tool Installation` TI
LEFT JOIN `tabTMS Tool Condition` TC
    ON TC.name = TI.tool_condition

Where TI.posting_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s
